device.title: Device
device.nothingAnswered: No device answered on this network
device.nothingAnsweredHint: mDNS is often blocked between network segments. This does not mean there is no device — try the IP address instead.
device.remoteIdHint: Enter the Remote ID shown on the device. The connection is set up for you — then sign in as usual.

photos.title: Photos
photos.libraryMissing: Photo search needs the Photos module
photos.libraryMissingHint: This device has no Photos module registered, so semantic search and facets are unavailable. Browsing and backup work regardless.
photos.backupForegroundOnly: Backup runs only while this window is open.
photos.noneHere: No pictures or videos in this folder.
photos.searchPlaceholder: Describe what should be in the picture
photos.semanticIncomplete: The semantic index is at {{percent}} %. Until it is complete, text search only matches whole words in file names.
photos.semanticUnavailable: Photo search is not available on this device
photos.semanticUnavailableHint: The device has no vision model installed, so a search would return nothing at all rather than no matches. Browsing and backup are unaffected.

files.title: Files
files.loadingVolumes: Asking the device for its volumes…
files.noVolumes: The device did not report a single volume, so there is nothing to browse.
files.searchPlaceholder: Search file names in this folder and below
files.searchSummary: {{hits}} hit(s) after looking at {{scanned}} entries. This search runs in the client — ZimaOS 1.7 has no server-side file search.
files.searchTruncated: Stopped early at the search limit, so there may be more matches further down.
files.tasksHint: Copying and moving run on the device, so they continue even when this window is busy.

apps.title: Apps
apps.cachedAt: as of {{time}} — the device did not answer just now
apps.none: No apps are installed on this device.
apps.noWebUi: This app publishes no web interface.

security.keyringPlaintext: This system provides no keyring ({{backend}}), so Electron would store credentials with a hardcoded password. Nothing has been saved.
security.backendChanged: The saved session cannot be read: the system keyring has changed. Please sign in again.
security.consentGiven: Storing without a keyring was allowed for this machine.

error.refused: The device refused the connection — nothing is listening on this port.
error.timeout: No answer at all — a firewall may be dropping the connection.
error.dns: The host name could not be resolved.
error.malformedResponse: The device answered in a form this client does not understand.
error.capabilityMissing: This device does not offer the required feature.
error.internal: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.
error.invalidCredentials: User name or password is wrong.
error.parameters: The device rejected the request as incomplete.
error.invalidHost: That is not a valid address.
error.invalidPort: That is not a valid port.
error.notAZimaDevice: No ZimaOS device answered at this address.
error.sessionExpired: The session has expired — please sign in again.
error.strategyUnavailable: This connection route could not be set up. The reason is shown below.
error.notFound: The device says this path does not exist.
error.endpointUnknown: This device does not offer the interface the client asked for.
error.invalidRequest: The request was rejected before it was sent — that is a defect in this client.
error.invalidFolderName: A folder name cannot contain a slash.
error.uploadNotAFile: Only regular files can be uploaded.
error.photosModuleMissing: This device has no photos module, so search and facets are unavailable.
error.appNotFound: This app is no longer in the device's list.
error.appHasNoWebUi: This app publishes no web interface.
error.powerDeviceMismatch: The screen refers to a different device than the active one. Reload and try again.
error.zerotierNoToken: The local ZeroTier token could not be read.
error.zerotierApi: The local ZeroTier service answered with an error.
error.zerotierMissing: No zerotier-one was found — neither installed nor shipped.
error.zerotierNoStart: The local ZeroTier service did not start.
error.unexpected-status: The device answered with an unexpected status.
error.zerotierNoCapability: The local ZeroTier service is not allowed to create a virtual network device. The exact command to grant that is below.
error.remoteIdUnknown: No Remote ID is stored for this device. Sign in once via "Connect via Remote ID".

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.notPersisted: Signed in, but the session was not saved — it will not survive a restart.
signIn.resumeFailed: The saved session could not be restored.

devices.title: Devices
devices.noneHint: Search the local network or enter an address directly.

backup.title: Photo backup
backup.foregroundOnly: only while this window is open
backup.explainer: Pick local folders; pictures and videos in them are uploaded to {{destination}}. There is no background sync, so the transfer stops when you close the window and continues where it left off next time.

power.title: Power
power.restarting: The restart was requested. The device will be unreachable for a while.
power.shuttingDown: The shutdown was requested. The device will not answer again until it is switched on.

zerotier.title: Remote ID (ZeroTier)
zerotier.hint: A public network admits this machine straight away. A private one has to authorise it first — the badge next to each network says which it is.
zerotier.hintAccessDenied: This network refused the machine (ACCESS_DENIED): it is private, and its owner has to authorise this node in the network controller.
zerotier.provisionHint: This app installs its own copy of zerotier-one. To let it create a network device it still needs one permission, which you grant yourself with a single command. The system's own ZeroTier is left untouched.
zerotier.commandHint: Run this once in a terminal, then connect again here:
zerotier.capable: The permission is in place. The daemon may create a network device.

legacy.title: Take over from the old client
legacy.explainer: Addresses from a 0.9 installation can be adopted. Passwords are not carried over — you sign in once, and the old configuration is never modified.

tailscale.title: Tailscale
tailscale.detectedOnly: Detected, not managed. This client uses a tunnel that is already running and changes no DNS or route settings.
tailscale.noPeers: No other machine on this tailnet is online.
